title: IELTS API: a free, no-authentication REST API and open dataset for IELTS preparation research
description: Archived release of the IELTS API source code and datasets, version 1.1.0: the Cambridge IELTS 1-22 vocabulary dataset, band descriptors and score concordances, task and topic banks, original CEFR-graded reading passages with exam-style items, an evidence-labelled learning-strategy bank, and deterministic generators for seeded vocabulary quizzes and weekly study plans. Cite this record, or the version-specific DOI, when you use the API or the datasets in research.
